overview: CompoDistill enhances the visual perception abilities of efficient Multimodal LLMs by identifying visual attention misalignment as a bottleneck and addressing it through a three-stage distillation framework that includes a Visual ATtention alignment (VAT) module and a Teacher Adapter Fetch (TAF) module.

modules.name: Multimodal Data Preprocessing & Loading
modules.description: Handles the construction of the visual instruction tuning datasets (e.g., LLaVA-mix), performing image transformations, tokenization, and formatting multimodal inputs to align with the MLLM architecture's requirements.

modules.name: MLLM Architecture Wrapper
modules.description: Defines the core Multimodal Large Language Model components, including the Vision Encoder, the LLM backbone, and the standard adapter, managing the forward pass of combined visual and textual inputs.

modules.name: Teacher Adapter Fetch (TAF) Module
modules.description: Implements the adapter mechanism that bridges the visual feature space gap by reusing the teacher's frozen pretrained adapter followed by a lightweight trainable MLP projection to align dimensions with the student LLM.

modules.name: Group Layer Matching Strategy
modules.description: Implements the one-to-many layer matching strategy using a sliding window approach, mapping each student's visual understanding layer to a group of consecutive teacher layers to handle depth mismatches.

modules.name: Visual Attention Alignment (VAT) Logic
modules.description: Extracts the visual attention sub-matrices (columns corresponding to visual tokens) from intermediate 'visual understanding layers' and implements the logic to compute the alignment between student and teacher attention maps.

modules.name: Loss Function Suite
modules.description: Implements the three core training objectives: the autoregressive Language Modeling loss, the Kullback-Leibler divergence loss for logit-level distillation, and the Cosine Distance-based Attention Distillation loss for VAT.

modules.name: Stage 1: Distilled Pre-Training (DPT)
modules.description: Implements the first training stage workflow, freezing the vision encoder and LLM while optimizing the TAF adapter module using language modeling and KL divergence losses to align the visual feature space.

modules.name: Stage 2: Distilled Fine-Tuning (DFT)
modules.description: Implements the second training stage workflow, co-optimizing the LLM and adapter while applying the VAT module to explicitly align the student's visual attention with the teacher's using the attention distillation loss.

modules.name: Stage 3: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT)
modules.description: Implements the final consolidation stage, fine-tuning the LLM and adapter using only the autoregressive language modeling loss to consolidate the transferred knowledge and strengthen instruction-following capabilities.

modules.name: Benchmark Evaluation Pipeline
modules.description: Executes inference on Visual Question Answering (VQA) and Compositional Reasoning (CR) benchmarks to compute accuracy metrics, evaluating both visual recognition and visual perception abilities.

modules.name: Attention Similarity Analyzer
modules.description: Implements the layer-wise analysis tool to compute the cosine similarity between teacher-student and teacher-SFT attention distributions over visual and text tokens, validating the correlation between alignment and performance.

modules.name: Visual Attention Heatmap Generator
modules.description: Generates visualizations of attention maps on input images to qualitatively demonstrate visual attention misalignment in baselines and the correction achieved by the VAT module.

modules.name: Ablation Study Configuration Manager
modules.description: Manages experimental configurations for ablation studies, including different attention loss types, target layer ranges, and layer matching strategies (Simple, Adaptive, Group).
